So far the Kwelahn have attempted to care for it on their own, feeding and hydrating it to keep it alive while waiting for outside help.[/i][/quote]

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;59747372][b]Thýven rises once more[/b]
In a dramatic change of events, the government of Thýven under King Erjk Drs has ordered an immediate mobilisation of 450,000 troops across the nation to begin transfer to the units on West Shamat in order to begin a formal march upon Sal-Baliz territory, in the meantime, pre-prepared missile strikes have begun effective immediately upon Sal-Baliz positions. No formal message is sent to the members of THEP or those involved in the invasion regarding these movements, with the move aimed at surprising Thývens allies.

[nation]BR Bob[/nation]

The specialist aid team left the camp at around 5:12am, in search of a settlement when they can speak to the Kwelahn. The soldiers spent an extra 2 hours packing up their camp and making final arrangements, before crossing the border back out into lawless territory at 7:46am. They have now begun the final stretch towards the Sal-Baliz border, where they will begin their invasion.

Later that day, back at a military satellite control station, Thývens missiles were detected hitting various military targets throughout Sal-Baliz. The military has sent various encoded transmissions back to the invasion forces, informing them of locations that may be hit. The government of Hydronia has sent a message to Thýven asking if they will be rejoining the security council.
